phase: prospective design controls only; no control executed
prerequisites_before_any_control: shared private NativeResult issue/claim/retire API frozen with the separate GCC stage-4 design
exact row and terminal maximum-size formulas frozen
deeply immutable JSON-encodable header mapping type frozen

pure_protocol_controls.name: retained-actual-transcript-positive
pure_protocol_controls.input: the retained valid actual header rows, in their real sequence, with a completion signed by a test-issued launch verifier
pure_protocol_controls.expected: accepted; every exact row is preserved as a deeply immutable semantic mapping

pure_protocol_controls.name: short-transcript-protocol-positive
pure_protocol_controls.input: a structurally valid actual transcript containing the unchanged minimum first statfs row and a valid launch-specific completion
pure_protocol_controls.expected: accepted only as a protocol fact about actual observations; no libselinux branch, vendor or native compatibility claim

pure_protocol_controls.name: repeated-actual-identity-positive
pure_protocol_controls.input: two or more valid actual rows with the same operation/path, distinct contiguous sequences, exact payloads and a valid launch-specific completion
pure_protocol_controls.expected: accepted; occurrence identity is sequence plus exact row content, not unique operation/path

pure_protocol_controls.name: transport-array-permutation-positive
pure_protocol_controls.input: permute the accessed array while preserving every row, sequence and completion byte-for-byte
pure_protocol_controls.expected: accepted because row sequence, not report array order, defines the transcript

pure_protocol_controls.name: omit-each-real-row-coherent-public-repair
pure_protocol_controls.input: for each retained real row, remove it, renumber survivors, recompute count and manifest digest, leave the original bound completion tag unchanged
pure_protocol_controls.expected: every mutation rejects; structural validation may reject first, otherwise HMAC verification rejects

pure_protocol_controls.name: mutate-each-real-row-coherent-public-repair
pure_protocol_controls.input: change each valid row field or payload in turn, preserve a structurally valid row where possible, recompute manifest digest and count, leave the original tag unchanged
pure_protocol_controls.expected: malformed payloads reject structurally; otherwise the unchanged tag rejects

pure_protocol_controls.name: duplicate-each-real-occurrence
pure_protocol_controls.input: insert a duplicate operation/path occurrence under a new sequence, renumber as needed, recompute public count and digest, leave the original tag unchanged
pure_protocol_controls.expected: reject on HMAC; the rejection is not an operation/path uniqueness rule

pure_protocol_controls.name: sequence-order-swap
pure_protocol_controls.input: swap the sequence numbers of two valid rows, preserve contiguous numbering, recompute count and digest, leave the original tag unchanged
pure_protocol_controls.expected: reject because actual ordered contents changed

pure_protocol_controls.name: gap-and-renumber-controls
pure_protocol_controls.input: create a sequence gap, duplicate sequence, zero sequence, over-limit sequence, or a coherent survivor renumbering after omission
pure_protocol_controls.expected: shape failures reject before authority; coherent renumbering with otherwise valid shape rejects on HMAC

pure_protocol_controls.name: count-and-digest-coherent-repair
pure_protocol_controls.input: alter rows and repair both public count and manifest digest without the native key
pure_protocol_controls.expected: reject on the unchanged launch tag

pure_protocol_controls.name: cross-launch-and-replay
pure_protocol_controls.input: copy an otherwise valid rows/completion set to another fresh launch, then attempt a second claim after success and after failure
pure_protocol_controls.expected: cross-launch verification and every replay reject

pure_protocol_controls.name: completion-shape
pure_protocol_controls.input: decimal V1 terminal, missing/repeated terminal, wrong field set/types/version/status/scope/binding, uppercase or wrong-length digest/tag, zero/over-limit count

pure_protocol_controls.name: existing-row-payload-preservation
pure_protocol_controls.input: malformed statfs length/hex/readonly flag/result, stream result/extent/hash/EOF, absent path/result/payload, foreign operation/path, missing profile
pure_protocol_controls.expected: continue to reject under the unchanged payload/profile contract

pure_protocol_controls.name: unchanged-minimum-evidence
pure_protocol_controls.input: validly signed transcript with no actual statfs /sys/fs/selinux row
pure_protocol_controls.expected: reject; no other permitted operation is made mandatory

pure_protocol_controls.name: actual-negative-row-retention
pure_protocol_controls.input: a transcript containing the real absent /etc/selinux/config row, then omit or alter that row and repair public count/digest without the key
pure_protocol_controls.expected: original accepts; omission/alteration rejects on HMAC or payload validation

pure_protocol_controls.name: stream-facts-remain-meaningful
pure_protocol_controls.input: actual stream rows with valid count/hash/EOF, then independently mutate each field with coherent manifest repair and unchanged tag
pure_protocol_controls.expected: original accepts; mutations reject; no raw-byte predicate or branch inference is introduced

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: verifier-consumed-on-all-sandbox-paths
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: the exact launch cannot be retried or replayed; key/config references are released and the config path is promptly unlinked

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: strict-success-before-authentication
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: instrument the authenticator call boundary across malformed, failed and successful reports
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: authentication and NativeResult issuance occur only after all generic report/accounting/execution/status checks succeed

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: forged-sandbox-return
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: _command receives completed/observed objects not registered by the exact successful _sandbox_run

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: same-object-post-issuance-mutation
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: mutate returncode, stdout, stderr or observed report content on the same objects after NativeResult issuance and before claim
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: claim fingerprint comparison rejects and retires the record

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: wrong-purpose-and-second-claim
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: claim a header result as the GCC purpose or claim the same exact result twice
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: reject; one common registry remains purpose-sealed and one-use

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: immutable-accepted-row
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: attempt ordinary mapping, list or nested-value mutation after authentication and after ProcessOutput construction
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: mutation is impossible/rejected; values are primitive and no mutable raw report object is retained

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: raw-report-mutation-after-claim
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: mutate or discard observed['accessed'] after the immutable transcript is claimed
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: accepted immutable rows and semantic projection remain unchanged; raw report has no authority

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: no-authority-reparse
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: replace the post-_sandbox_run raw header parser result while leaving no valid NativeResult claim
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: reject; parser success, raw rows and completion strings cannot create ProcessOutput authority

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: failure-has-no-output-or-cache
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: valid native stdout followed by any completion/authentication/claim/custody failure
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: no output publication, ProcessOutput, runtime_probes, generated result, cache entry or semantic dynamic-command record

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: secret-and-entropy-nonpublication
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: receipt key is absent everywhere after trusted config use; tag/scope/binding/digest/count do not enter ProcessOutput/cache/semantics

lifecycle_and_custody_controls.name: cleanup-without-zeroization-claim
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.input: inspect all success/failure ownership paths and documentation wording
lifecycle_and_custody_controls.expected: prompt config unlink and reference removal are enforced; no assertion promises CPython/fork/HMAC memory zeroization

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: completion-capacity-reserved
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: consume observation count/bytes up to the boundary before and during filter execution
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: the terminal reservation is made before execution; capacity exhaustion fails closed without a signed prefix

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: row-preallocation-admission
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: exercise count and byte boundaries for every legal row kind
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: count and fixed worst-case row storage are checked before per-row dictionary/string allocation; actual encoding never exceeds the admitted maximum

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: no-private-row-list
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: source/AST structural check of Policy filter state
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: only sequence, incremental hash state, row-present state and key lifecycle state exist; no ordered row list or duplicate private transcript

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: incremental-manifest-equivalence
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: valid transcripts of one row, retained rows and repeated rows
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: guard incremental digest equals SHA-256 of the existing canonical encoded ordered list exactly

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: fault-between-hash-and-publication
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: inject encoding, hash, observation charge and publication faults around one row
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: run fails and emits no accepted signed completion; no prefix is promoted

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: report-and-nested-decode-bounds
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: maximum and oversized report files, row strings, terminal strings, counts and accepted-copy sizes
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: existing file/control/count limits reject before unbounded nested decode or accepted-copy retention

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: semantic-cache-precharge
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: exhaust cache/control capacity immediately before immutable ProcessOutput projection
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: charge failure occurs before projection/ProcessOutput/cache retention

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: legitimate-many-repeats-within-existing-limits
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: more than five valid repeated actual occurrences, all within existing count/byte/deadline limits and correctly signed
cardinality_and_storage_controls.expected: accepted; no hidden five-row cap or uniqueness rule

cardinality_and_storage_controls.name: repeat-beyond-existing-limit
cardinality_and_storage_controls.input: valid occurrences exceeding existing observation, report, file, syscall or deadline authority

schema_and_edge_controls: Filter launch V2 has exactly version, scope, binding and receipt_key; header-search V1 remains exactly unchanged.
Filter profile remains version 1 with exact current statfs/read/absent paths and presence booleans.
Completion V2 has exactly version, scope, binding, status, count, manifest_sha256 and tag.
Supervisor report top-level keys remain unchanged and closed.
No opaque Python capability or marker is serialized into the report or _sandbox_run return tuple.
_sandbox_run authenticates before issuing one purpose-sealed NativeResult.
_command claims the exact registered completed/observed objects before runtime_probes, cache, semantics or output publication.
ProcessOutput header rows are deeply immutable and retain the exact existing eight-key semantic JSON shape.
No key, tag, scope entropy, binding, digest or completion count enters semantic/cache identity.
Default non-filter and header-search V1 paths remain unchanged.
No new graph owner, tester case, module, profile path, permission, namespace mode, dependency or resource limit is introduced.

mutation_and_restoration_controls.mutation: replace signed completion authentication with the old decimal count and post-_sandbox_run raw records parser
mutation_and_restoration_controls.expected_failure: the omit-each-row coherent-repair control becomes accepted, so the regression suite fails

mutation_and_restoration_controls.name: remove-hmac-check

mutation_and_restoration_controls.expected_failure: forged-return, same-object mutation or no-authority-reparse controls fail

mutation_and_restoration_controls.name: make-accepted-rows-mutable
mutation_and_restoration_controls.mutation: store tuple-of-dicts from the raw parser as authority
mutation_and_restoration_controls.expected_failure: immutable accepted-row and raw-report mutation controls fail

mutation_and_restoration_controls.name: add-private-ordered-list
mutation_and_restoration_controls.mutation: retain a second guard-side ordered row list for completion

mutation_and_restoration_controls.name: parallel-native-result-gateway

explicit_test_key_limit.rule: Negative report-mutation controls never receive the native key; they retain the original tag while coherently repairing public fields.
explicit_test_key_limit.reason: A test that gives malicious trusted observer code the key and lets it sign forged data tests an out-of-scope compromised signer, not this report-boundary contract.
permitted_test_key_use: prove repeated actual occurrences are accepted when genuinely signed

future_native_control_after_separate_fre.scope: the smallest existing real header case only
future_native_control_after_separate_fre.required_evidence: the actually observed transcript is authenticated, each real-row mutation without the key rejects, and output/cache/semantics remain absent on failure
future_native_control_after_separate_fre.qualification_limit: It may qualify only the exact runtime/profile actually executed. It cannot establish early-return, statvfs aggregation, vendor-version or all-libselinux behavior.
